name: App switches in chat
author: wizard
description: A reply's switch card also shows an app's own feature switches (like Calendar's or Messenger's), not only Wizard's: the switch's name, what it does and whether it is on right now, flipped right there in the chat. When the app on this Wizard doesn't have that switch yet, the row is greyed with "Update <app> first" and an Update button (wizard-ux issue 1560).
